title: Leaving the Cotton Club for one-nighters and Cab Calloway
summary: When Duke left the Cotton Club for one-nighters, Tizol rehearsed Cab Calloway's incoming band; Ellington's orchestra did huge business on the road.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: At the Cotton Club, when we left the Cotton Club, I rehearsed with Cab Calloway's band that followed us, you know, we left to go on one nighters then; to go all over the country, and I rehearsed with Cab Calloway all the music for his show. We went on the road and we were breaking records all over the place, you know? Because Duke Ellington's orchestra got so big! Oh, we did tremendous business.
